name: X (droid)
description: X was a battle droid active during the Galactic Civil War. He was found in his manufacturer Kyrotech Corporate Combine's warehouse by a spaceport worker. Via the black market, the latter sold the droid to the pirate leader Zhen Mirat. During a confrontation Mirat's gang had with a group of Rebel Alliance agents, the latter discovered that X had a programmed-in weakness.
